map.根据体重、年龄、性别和活动量计算每日推荐饮水量: Calculate your daily recommended water intake from weight, age, sex and activity level
map.📖 查看「每日饮水量计算器使用指南」: 📖 View the "Daily Water Intake Calculator User Guide"
map.基础量(ml) = 体重(kg) × 年龄分段系数（≤1岁 120、≤3岁 11: Baseline (ml) = weight (kg) × age-bracket factor (≤1y 120, ≤3y 110, ≤6y 100, ≤10y 80, ≤14y 60; adult male 35, female 30)
map.总量 = 基础 × 活动系数 × 天气系数 × 特殊情况系数: Total = baseline × activity factor × weather factor × special-case factor
map.科学分配饮水时间，分次饮用更健康: Distribute drinking times scientifically; sipping in portions is healthier
map.* 建议每次饮用200-250ml，少量多次，不要等到口渴再喝: * Drink 200-250 ml each time, in small amounts but often; do not wait until thirsty
map.短时间内大量饮水（如几小时内超过3-4升），导致体内电解质稀释，引发低钠血症，严: Drinking a large amount of water in a short time (e.g. more than 3-4 liters within a few hours) dilutes the body's electrolytes, causing hyponatremia that can be life-threatening in severe cases.
map.• 严重时可能导致昏迷甚至死亡: • In severe cases can lead to coma or even death
map.• 每小时饮水量不超过1升: • Drink no more than 1 liter per hour
map.• 全天饮水量不超过体重(kg)×60ml: • Daily water intake not exceeding weight (kg) × 60 ml
map.• 运动时补充含电解质的饮料: • During exercise, drink beverages containing electrolytes
map.• 不要强迫自己大量饮水: • Do not force yourself to drink large amounts
map.部分食物也能提供水分，可计入每日总摄入量: Some foods also provide water and can count toward your daily total
map.* 一般食物可提供每日约20%的水分摄入: * Ordinary food can provide about 20% of daily water intake
map.• 温水最佳，避免过冷过热: • Warm water is best; avoid very cold or very hot
map.• 餐前30分钟喝水有助于消化: • Drinking 30 minutes before a meal aids digestion
map.• 睡前1小时适量喝水，降低血液粘稠度: • Drink a moderate amount 1 hour before bed to reduce blood viscosity
map.这些时候记得喝水: Remember to drink at these times
map.• 起床后空腹一杯水（300ml左右）: • A glass of water (about 300 ml) on an empty stomach after waking
map.• 运动前、中、后都要补水: • Rehydrate before, during and after exercise
map.• 洗澡前后各喝一杯水: • A glass of water before and after a bath
map.• 长时间坐在空调房要定时喝水: • Drink regularly when sitting in air-conditioning for a long time
map.• 坐飞机时要多喝水（空气干燥）: • Drink more on flights (the air is dry)
map.喝什么水最好？: What kind of water is best?
map.最经济、最健康的选择: the most economical and healthiest choice
map.适量饮用有益健康: moderate drinking is good for health
map.含糖饮料、碳酸饮料、浓咖啡: sugary drinks, carbonated drinks, strong coffee
map.本计算器结果仅供参考，不能替代专业医生的诊断和建议。饮水量因人而异，肾病、心脏病: This calculator's results are for reference only and cannot replace a professional doctor's diagnosis and advice. Water needs vary between individuals; special groups such as those with kidney or heart disease should follow medical advice. If symptoms of severe dehydration or water intoxication appear, seek medical care immediately.
map.按体重给基础饮水量：基础需求通常按体重估算（约 30-35 ml/kg/天），再: Baseline intake by weight: the baseline need is usually estimated by weight (about 30-35 ml/kg/day), then adjusted upward for activity, temperature, pregnancy/lactation and so on to get the daily total target.
map.拆分到全天分次饮用：把总量分配到起床后、三餐前后、上下午、睡前等时段，每段时间给: Split across the day: distribute the total across after waking, around meals, morning/afternoon and before bed, with a suggested amount for each period to avoid a single large gulp and frequent night waking.
map.运动 / 高温额外补充：运动出汗或高温环境时追加补给（如每运动 30 分钟 +1: Extra for exercise/high heat: add more when sweating during exercise or in hot environments (e.g. +150-250 ml per 30 minutes of exercise) to stay hydrated without overloading the digestive system.
map.算例：默认参数下的分次饮水表: Example: drinking schedule with default parameters
map.工具按体重与活动生成约 9 个时段：06:30 起床空腹 310ml、08:00: Based on weight and activity the tool generates about 9 periods: 06:30 after waking on an empty stomach 310 ml, 08:00 after breakfast 260 ml, 10:00 work break 260 ml, 11:30 before lunch 200 ml, 13:30 after lunch break 260 ml, 15:30 afternoon tea 260 ml, 17:30 before leaving work 200 ml, 19:30 after dinner 260 ml, 21:00 before bed 150 ml, totaling about 2.1 L,
map.一定要喝到推荐量吗？: Must I drink the recommended amount?
map.推荐量是参考，实际以「口渴即喝、尿色淡黄」为准。心肾疾病、心衰等需限水人群请遵医: The recommended amount is a reference; in practice follow "drink when thirsty and pale-yellow urine". People who need fluid restriction, such as those with heart or kidney disease or heart failure, should follow medical advice and not drink excessively.
map.茶、咖啡、汤算不算？: Do tea, coffee and soup count?
map.算一部分。茶咖含咖啡因有轻微利尿，但总体仍贡献水分；汤粥水分也可计入。完全靠咖啡: They count partly. Tea and coffee contain caffeine and are mildly diuretic but still contribute fluid overall; the water in soup and porridge also counts. Replacing plain water entirely with coffee is not recommended; plain water should remain the main source.
